2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.
02/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120(B) of the I.P.C. and Sections 66B, 66C & 66D of the I.T. Act , pending in the Court of learned Special Judge,

3.

sentences.text: It appears that mobile phone, e-gadget and cash amount were recovered from the possession of the petitioner.
It further appears that victim has claimed that mobile phone, recovered from the possession of the petitioner, was used in cheating him.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has remained in custody for about a year.
7. Considering the period of custody, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Jamtara in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No.
02/2024.
